$comment: Copy with: npm run new-tenant -- <id> "<Company name>" --industries k12,nonprofit. One file per Ionic operating company. Read docs/adding-a-tenant.md.

profile.profileNote: The drafter builds response skeletons from these fields and nothing else. Only put approved, substantiated claims here. Empty fields become [TODO] markers in the draft rather than invented text.

competitorsNote: Named in a posting page → tagged on the finding and a Competitive notes section in the draft. Public names only.

criteria.label: Our product meets most mandatory requirements
We know the buyer, or had contact before the RFP
We have a strong reference in this segment
We can produce a quality response by the deadline
Budget or value is worth the pursuit cost
No incumbent lock-in, or the incumbent is vulnerable
We have delivery capacity if we win

goNoGoNote: Optional. Omit to use the defaults. Weights must total 100. People answer each criterion yes / partial / no in the dashboard; the decision stays theirs.
teamNote: Role titles only, never people's names. Feeds the Assignee dropdown.
